_comment: Portable URL-based MCP server catalogue. scripts/sync-agent-rules.sh converts it for OpenCode and Pi; Claude Code has its own file: claude/.claude/mcp-servers.json.
_note: Stdio servers (qmd, cgc) are tool-specific — configure per tool manually.
_secrets: OpenCode expands {env:VAR} (no $); Pi sync transforms it to ${VAR}. Add actual values to ~/secrets/.env

sentry._note: OAuth — no API key needed. Authenticate via browser on first use.
